audit_scope.actual_file: Both full units and complete proofs read. The final three-hunk precision diff was read and exactly reproduced from the original snapshot.
checks: The matrix conjugacy count is converted to an actual Hom count by multiplying by the ambient matrix-group order. Injectivity of each model into the matrix group then gives a surjection from actual Hom sets onto the required permutation classes. No false injection from permutation classes into ambient conjugacy classes is used.

The affine block-matrix representation is faithful. The Gaussian-binomial lower bound is factorwise valid; flag fixation implies every k-subspace and hence every line is fixed, giving projective faithfulness.
The matrix costs for all standard models of size N are O(log squared N), and the number of possible field/dimension/flag-type models is polynomial in N.

Joined controlled quotient orbits, modelled transitive parts, and uncontrolled square-energy parts are counted with explicit overcounting assignments. All choices are fixed before n; no geometric realization of every abstract model is assumed.
The disconnected factor-assignment exponent now uses b_C, the actual number of marked points on that detecting curve, independently of the number w of whole local surface groups.

The existing complete-local type, fixed-formal curve-fibre, detecting-surjection and finite-normalization arguments transfer unchanged. The selected alternating-product consequence uses the same exact polynomial multiplicity and LMT/Goursat/compactness theorem.
